title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Connection Management Verification
verification_method: Focused loopback integration tests and unit tests for idle timeout helpers, connection reuse, explicit close, and in-progress query tracking.
scope: This verification covers the DoqClient connection lifecycle: idle timeout negotiation, reuse safety checking, explicit DOQ_NO_ERROR close, in-progress query tracking, and connection failure abandonment.
preconditions: Managed QUIC loopback support is available for integration tests.
expected_result: All DoQ tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts including slice 0011, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoQ client now manages connection lifecycle with idle timeout negotiation, reuse safety checks, explicit DOQ_NO_ERROR close, and in-progress query tracking. Focused loopback proof covers outstanding-query disposal with DOQ_NO_ERROR and idle-dispose negative behavior. All 11 REQs are traced and verified.
